ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are two concentric or approximately concentric conducting circular rings; the larger circular ring outside is labeled P, and the smaller circular ring inside is labeled Q. The magnetic field symbol “×” is drawn only in the annular region between ring P and ring Q, indicating that the magnetic field direction is perpendicular to the paper surface inward, that is, vertically downward as stated in the problem; no magnetic field symbol is drawn inside ring Q. Reasoning: For each closed conducting circular ring, separately look at whether the magnetic flux through the area it encloses changes with time. No magnetic field passes through the internal region enclosed by ring Q, so the magnetic flux in ring Q does not change, and there is no induced current in ring Q. The area enclosed by ring P includes the annular magnetic-field region between P and Q, and the vertically downward magnetic field in this region increases uniformly with time, so the downward magnetic flux passing through ring P increases, and there is an induced current in ring P. According to Lenz's law, the magnetic field produced by the induced current should hinder the increase of the downward magnetic flux, so it should produce a vertically upward magnetic field. From the right-hand rule, it can be known that the current direction producing a vertically upward magnetic field is counterclockwise.

method.method_draft: 分别按每个闭合导电圆环所围面积计算磁通量变化。先从图中识别：P是外圆环，Q是内圆环，磁场符号“×”只分布在P与Q之间的环形区域，表示磁场垂直纸面向里/竖直向下；Q内部没有磁场。再结合文字：该向下磁场随时间均匀增强。对Q环来说，它所围的内部区域没有磁场穿过，磁通量不变，所以Q中无感应电流。对P环来说，它所围面积包含P、Q之间的环形磁场区域，向下磁通量正在增大，因此P中有感应电流。根据楞次定律，感应电流要产生竖直向上的磁场来阻碍向下磁通量增加；用右手定则判断，产生向上磁场的电流方向为逆时针。因此只有P环中有逆时针方向的感应电流。
